summary: This document describes requirements, architecture and solutions for protecting point-to-point services in a ring of MPLS Transport Profile nodes. It defines a Ring Protection Switching protocol so traffic can be quickly steered around a failure, meeting the ring protection requirements of RFC 5654.

eli5.summary: Picture cars driving around a circular road. If part of the road is blocked, they turn around and go the other way round the circle to still reach their destination.

questions: how does mpls-tp ring protection work
